name: site-nav
title: SiteNav
description: The masthead's nav cluster: primary nav-links + affordances (SearchPalette trigger + theme-cycler). The host owns the band, wordmark and mobile sheet; SiteNav is the cluster inside it. Cross-surface with per-mode variant: reception shows the full set, article hides search per CD1 Concept 7 sanctuary, mobile renders the host sheet's contents. Magnetic nav links + layoutId active-page indicator (motion).

meta.primeForwardPointer: B16 port (2026-08-31): the microsite fork's architecture became the library component — host-owned band, motion-driven links, hosted theme-cycler (spec Field 6), A13 conditional aria-controls on the SearchPalette trigger seam. MastheadWordmark registryDependency removed with the band; full file content inlining + MCP server registration land at W5+.
